description: Search the curated Agent Switchboard directory of AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic tools. Filter by task, category slug, access methods, official (first-party listings from major vendors), verified, and/or auth type; sort by relevance, newest, most skills, or name. Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working. Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified. Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

access.description: Require ALL of these access methods: api, mcp, cli, browser-extension ("extension" is accepted as an alias of browser-extension)

auth.description: Only listings with one of these auth types: none (no key or sign-in needed), apiKey, oauth2, bearer. A listing has one auth type, so several mean any of them

official.description: Only first-party listings from major vendors (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP)

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, skills, categories, tags, and provider

sort.description: Result order. relevance (default): best match first with search text; without it, best fit first for a task, else featured then A→Z. newest: most recently added first. skills: most skills first. name: A→Z

task.description: Task slug, e.g. "query-a-database": only the listings that do that job, best fit first. GET https://agentswitchboard.dev/api/tasks lists the tasks

verified.description: Only Verified listings: checked to work, re-checked monthly

name: search_agents

featured.description: Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

iconUrl.description: Absolute URL of the listing's 128px PNG icon, served by Agent Switchboard; null when it has none
